question.text: A projectile is launched at an angle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> with the horizontal with a velocity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. After <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>, its inclination with horizontal is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>tan</mi><mi>β</mi></math> will be : <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>.

solution.text:
Component of velocity in horizontal direction,

vx=20cosα=v2cosβ

Component of velocity in vertical direction,

vy=20sinα-g×10=v2sinβ

⇒tanβ=20sinα-10020cosα

⇒tanβ=tanα-5cosα

⇒tanβ=tanα-5secα
